messages:
Alex K: alerting — noticing P95/P99 latency drift in eu-west-2 over the last 30m, correlates with continuous batching pressure. dashboard: https://redwood/grafana/d/serving/eu-west-2-batching?from=now-1h :eyes:
Infra Bot: [ALERT] latency_slo_violation eu-west-2 / model:rw-large / metric:P99 / value:1.9s / threshold:1.0s
Meera R: thanks — is this mostly max-batch saturation or queueing behind prefill?
Alex K: looks like both. admission rate is stable, but max-batch window is filling with many small requests + ongoing prefill KV spikes. packing efficiency dropped ~30% -> token throughput per GPU down.
Josh T: can you paste the exact query patterns? small payloads vs long context?
Alex K: mix — 60% short (<64 tokens) interactive; 25% medium (64-512); the rest are long prefill heavy tails. prefills are causing KV cache evictions, we then see repeated prefill retries, which ratchets batch head and prevents efficient packing.
Carla S: are there any recent routing changes? I thought we had EU routing pinned to dedicated pool.
Meera R: we did a regional failover test yesterday night (eu-west-2 -> eu-central) for a few tenants. It looks like some clients were sticky and kept hitting eu-west-2, increasing hot-shard pressure.
André P: cost note: burst-to-dedicated on eu-west-2 is expensive. If we force overflow to eu-central we'd pay cross-region egress + higher compute margin. Need SRE signoff.
Josh T: quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily lower max_batch for rw-large to reduce queue head buildup; 2) enable more aggressive prefill-throttling for long contexts; 3) shift a subset of client traffic to eu-central pool; 4) short-term increase dedicated capacity (spin new nodes).
Meera R: 1 and 2 are low-risk and revertible. 3 needs routing policy change and may cause tail latency due to cross-region. 4 takes 20-30m to provision.
Alex K: I'm leaning 1 + 2 immediately. lowering max_batch from 128 -> 64 could reduce P99 but might increase per-token costs. Trade-off: latency SLO vs cost.
Carla S: can we do a targeted rollout? only for tenants with >10% request share in the hot shard.
Josh T: yes we can add an admission override for the hot shard and apply a canary to tenant_ids [4321, 9981, 1102].
Infra Bot: deploy-started: admission-override/hot-shard-cap-2026 by Josh T
André P: cost projection: if we reduce batch size and keep same instance count, throughput falls ~22% — estimated extra spend = +18% for next 6 hours if we don't autoscale down. If we spin up +2 nodes it's +30% for the hour, but reduces SLO violations.
Alex K: action plan: Meera to enable prefill-throttle patch, Josh to deploy admission override canary to the three tenant_ids, Carla to watch dashboard and rollback if tail doesn't improve; André will pre-approve capacity bump if needed.
Meera R: will push prefill-throttle now. Patch will reject redundant prefill after 2 retries and set backoff header to client.
Josh T: canary admission override deployed to canary subset. override sets max_batch=64 and increases admission-priority for small payloads.
Carla S: seeing immediate drop in queue depth on the hot shard, P95 improving. P99 still high but trending down :thumbsup:
Alex K: any increase in errors or 429s?
Josh T: small uptick in 429 for long requests on canary tenants, ~0.4% — clients get backoff header so they can retry later.
André P: if 429s climb, we should consider short-term spin of +1 node in the pool rather than keep throttling. I'll pre-approve one node for now.
Infra Bot: deploy-finished: admission-override/hot-shard-cap-2026 status=success
Meera R: prefill-throttle merged and in prod. also added metric prefill_eviction_rate which we can use for automated alerts.
Alex K: good work. next steps: 1) keep canary for 45m, 2) if P99 < 1.0s then roll to full hot shard, 3) follow-up runbook doc update to include prefill-throttle knobs and tenant-targeted admission overrides. I'll create the PR for runbook.
Carla S: adding to agenda for postmortem: why did routing sticky test not drain clients properly and why KV evictions spiked during the failover test.
Josh T: noted. adding log snippet: ```
2026-03-18T15:01:23Z WARN prefill: eviction_count=1243 shard=eu-west-2 node=n-34
2026-03-18T15:02:01Z INFO admission: batch_head_fill=98% max_batch=128 tenant=4321
```
Meera R: thumbs up. Will keep monitoring and update thread in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex K: thanks team — appreciate fast triage.
Carla S: +1 — great coordination :clap:
